# Vendored: the editor, as one ESM bundle

`ring-doc-bundle.js` is ported from commonwealth-ai cmnwlth/apps/ring-doc/vendor/ring-doc-bundle.js@47b8acfd0, byte for byte.
It was built there once by `npx esbuild@0.25 --bundle --format=esm` from
`yjs@13.6.32`, `@tiptap/core@3.31.3`, `@tiptap/starter-kit@3.31.3`,
`@tiptap/y-tiptap@3.0.9`, `@tiptap/extension-collaboration@3.31.3`,
`@tiptap/extension-collaboration-caret@3.31.3` and `y-protocols@1.0.7`
(commonwealth-ai `ralph/next/ring-doc/STATE.md`, row rd-1-scaffold). Nothing
is fetched at run time.
